searchText: Some BLS EIPs: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2333 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2334 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/2335 yep @benjaminion, that repo should contain other APIs as we agree on some standards. 😂 "Previous cross-shard communication (approximate)" (https://blog.ethereum.org/2019/10/31/eth2-quick-update-no-2/) i think that's actually an unedited photo of cross shard calls in the wild.. is it recommended/a good idea to disable all bls verification in block processing in an initial sync (syncing by range to the finalized root) to make syncing faster? with the idea that after the sync, the finalized root will either match at the end or not and if not, the sync can be reverted and tried again? I believe this is safe to do for all operations except deposits Since those can be processed but still have the signature fail somehow oh, yeah, good point has anyone ran minimal spec test on `justification_and_finalization` for v0.9.0 yet? I saw a few pyspec test bugs in those tests, the last attestation in pre state's data slot is the same as state slot <@363800010518822915> bug reports are welcome will open an issue : )
